messages:
Maria (sales_ops): Quick async check — Avisera deal update: customer asking about on‑prem HSM + BYOK. Need a short answer doc we can include in the SOW and a security signoff ETA by EOD. Any blockers?

Raj (AE): What I did: updated the SOW and the pricing sheet. Blocker: no definitive answer yet on HSM integration details. Today: will try to get buyer to confirm timelines + loop in legal. Can somebody confirm whether we support key wrap vs KMS proxy?

Nicole (solutions_eng): I can draft a 1‑page note for sales. Quick Q: do we need a network diagram for their on‑prem gateway or is a config snippet enough? I have a 3pm PT opening to hop on a call if helpful.

Luis (security): Short answer: yes — we support on‑prem HSM via our Private deployment and Dedicated with customer KMS/HSM. High level: customer either provides an HSM + cert or we integrate with their KMS endpoint (mutual TLS). Key wrap (customer‑wrapped keys) is supported but needs KMS policy + audit logging enabled.

Luis (security): Risk notes: will need formal attestation + HSM inventory for SOC2 and may require additional network firewall rules. Also watch latency — HSM signing on each key unwrap can add ~15–50ms per init depending on their hardware.

Luis (security): Example config snippet to include in the note:```yaml
hsm_integration:
  mode: customer_kms
  key_wrap: true
  kms_endpoint: "https://kms.customer.example:443"
  mTLS: true
  required_audit_logs: ["key_wrap_events", "auth_events"]
```

Maria (sales_ops): Perfect — Nicole, can you turn that into a 3‑bullet sales note + the config snippet? Raj, I'll add it to the SOW and send to buyer after security thumbs up.

Nicole (solutions_eng): Yep, I'll post a draft in this thread in ~30m. Will include a friendly one‑liner for the buyer and the snippet.

Raj (AE): Thanks. FYI to legal: please expect an SOW addendum for BYOK + HSM clauses.

dealbot: Avisera (ACCT‑1942) moved from "negotiation" → "legal review" by Raj (AE). :paperclip:

Luis (security): One more: ask customer for HSM vendor and FIPS level. If it's a non‑FIPS device we should note it. Also confirm whether they require HSM inside their VPC or physically hosted at their DC.

Maria (sales_ops): Noted. I'll collect vendor + FIPS + network details on the call. If security can sign off on the draft by EOD that keeps us on track for next week's pilot. :pray:

Nicole (solutions_eng): Draft posted: https://redwood.internal/notes/avisera‑hsm‑sales‑note (internal). Ping me directly if you want edits.

Raj (AE): On it — will ping legal + buyer, and circle back with the vendor details after the call.

Maria (sales_ops): Great, that's the async check. No other blockers from sales team side. Thanks all :thumbsup:
